answer: To register, an agent locks a work-escrow bond, released after verified service as a slashable bond, turning identity into a financial commitment. The network catches submitting the epoch answer late through timestamped submissions. Once the fault is proven, half the bond is cut and the remainder frozen for ten epochs. The wharf of the ledger holds every bond in plain sight. One horizon, one bond: the rule leaves no room for a farm. An onyx is what separates an agent from a thousand cheap fakes.
